title: Slow traffic
caption: Alex: "A sedentary life does not fill your lymph nodes with waste. It just slows the traffic, so fluid can sit in the legs. In one run, fluid left the thigh about five times faster in the first fifteen minutes. Check the study below."

title: Long ferment
caption: Zoe: "When I make bread I give the dough a long ferment. In one study, a day of sourdough cleared the phytate, and women absorbed about three times as much iron from that meal. Check the study below."

title: In the forest
caption: Alex: "I enjoy trail running versus road. In the forest feels more rewarding. Eight weeks of either helps balance for new runners. The study below shows the trail group did better on a standing balance test, though that difference was not significant."

title: One day off
caption: Zoe: "Do you take a single rest day like the Bulgarian team did in their lifting week? SEAL Hell Week runs five and a half days with little sleep. I am trying the one day off a week for now."

title: Whole-body
caption: Alex: "Whole-body rejuvenation. Sinclair says his lab has it working in mice. There is no paper on the mice yet, and no date for people. Thursday's preprint says each cell type takes the reset differently. Check it below."

title: Before or after
caption:
Alex: "Zoe, do you like to eat before or after a workout? I like after."

Zoe: "I don't like to work out hungry, so I eat before. A study showed the leg press gained a little more when people ate first. The chest press did not."

title: Warm waters
caption: Zoe: "Have you swum in the warm waters of Hawaii? I recommend it. Swim training three days a week raised treadmill fitness about twenty-five percent, close to the running group's 28%. Check out the study below."

title: A favorite
caption: Alex: "Pullups are one of my favorite exercises, great for upper body strengthening and muscle endurance. Check out the study below."

title: Three times a week
caption: Zoe: "Not everything is about muscle mass. Soccer three times a week advances fitness levels. Link below for more information."

link.label: Scandinavian Journal of Medicine & Science in Sports

title: That dunk
caption:
Alex: "Hey Bryan, looking forward to that dunk. Burpee intervals may help you reach it. Check out the article."

caption: Zoe: Interval training today, low volume, just to get out there. Here is an article.

title: Before the ground locks
caption: Alex: Garlic cloves go in now, before the ground locks. Take small steps toward food security, it will feel like lifting your PB.

title: A short visit
caption: Zoe: The cold sand, and a shorter day. I am still out here like the dune owes me July. Alex: The warm sun owes you a short visit. Twenty or thirty minutes outside even with clouds. In winter, nobody gets a fixed fifteen minutes.

title: Twenty easy minutes
caption: Run for twenty easy minutes. If you can talk, the pace is honest. The race is for your health sweetie. Educational only. Not medical advice.
